name: Necrotoxic
body:
School necromancy; Level cleric/oracle 4, death mage 3, shaman 4, sorcerer/wizard 4, white necromancer 3, witch 4

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, DF

EFFECT

Range touch
Target undead creature touched
Duration instantaneous; see text
Saving Throw Fort negates; see text; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You inflict the touched undead with a magical poison that only destroys undead. Undead are not immune to the Fortitude save from this spell. The poison deals 1d3 Charisma damage per round for 6 rounds. Undead are not immune to this ability score damage. Poisoned undead can make a Fortitude save each round to negate the damage and end the affliction.
